title: checkpoint_retries configuration -- the top-level 'checkpointing' block (architecture sections 3.1, 4)
description: Granularity, retries, backoff: a wrapper around the whole composition, not an ordered step. It is declared once, in the product's top-level 'checkpointing' block, never as an entry in 'steps' -- this schema therefore carries no 'pattern' key, unlike every other pattern's step schema. 'checkpoint' is the verification hook of architecture section 12: declared true, it forces table materialisation intent for the product and registers the product's relation in the emitted graph (ergasterion/framework/graph.py). It is the only materialisation intent a product declaration carries; everything else about physical layout is adapter convention and estate policy.
